checks.name: remote API access boundary and single-user loopback architecture
checks.evidence: [packages/server/src/index.ts:5-8] refuses non-loopback HOST values unless SURFACETRACE_API_TOKEN is set, and [packages/server/src/app.ts:317-348] rejects non-loopback API requests without a valid bearer token while keeping the default CORS origin set loopback-only. [packages/server/test/app.test.ts:9-22] exercises the non-loopback denial and bearer-token allow path.

checks.name: evidence record ID tamper detection
checks.evidence: [packages/core/src/evidence/ledger.ts:41-52] recomputes chain hashes and rejects records when `id !== contentHash.slice(0, 24)`, and [packages/core/test/core.test.ts:265-287] includes a regression test that detects `id` mutation.

checks.name: canonical three-agent roster integrity
checks.evidence: [scripts/security-team.mjs:6-16,79-85] hard-codes the three-agent roster per team, hashes the manifest scope including the agent list, and freezes if `manifest.agents` does not exactly match the canonical roster.

checks.name: receipt contract validation
checks.evidence: [security-teams/receipt-schema.json:5-34] defines the required receipt fields, allowed status/result enums, and non-empty check list, and [scripts/security-team.mjs:23-32] enforces object shape, required fields, hash/status validity, and non-empty evidence-bearing checks.

checks.name: blocking of failed or untested checks
checks.evidence: [scripts/security-team.mjs:90-94] blocks any receipt whose final status is not PASS and any receipt containing check results other than PASS; the schema also only permits PASS, FAIL, or NOT_TESTED for individual checks.

limitations: Passive source and test review only; no network traffic was sent.
`node --test` was partially blocked in this environment by Windows temp-directory EPERM / module-resolution issues, so runtime verification is limited to the source-backed checks above.
